summary: Two-step delete button: the first click arms it and a pixel fuse burns down; a second click inside the window confirms with a burst.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Seconds the armed state lasts before it cancels.

props.name: doneText
props.description: Label shown for 2 s after confirming.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called on the second click inside the window.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the armed state ends without confirming: Escape, the button losing focus, or the timeout.

accessibility: A native `<button>`; its accessible name is the visible label.
The label is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so the confirm prompt and the done text are announced.
Moving focus away while armed cancels.
The fuse is drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas; the remaining time is not exposed.
motion: With reduced motion labels swap without rolling and the confirm burst is skipped; the fuse still burns down.
notes: After confirming, clicks are ignored for 2 s, then the button returns to idle. The root carries `data-state="armed"` or `data-state="done"` in those states.
The root is a wrapper `span` around the button, so the sparks can fly past the button's edges.
The timeout runs on a timer, so it also expires while the button is off screen or the tab is hidden.
